summary_en: Toyo Drilube issued a correction to its September 11, 2026 disclosure on capital cost and share price-conscious management initiatives. The revision addressed an omission in the IR activity enhancement section on page 5 of the materials.

summary_en: Toyo Drilube updated its capital cost and stock price-conscious management targets. The company reanalyzed current performance and revised progress toward its capital efficiency objectives first announced in September 2024.
